newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr bond yields end flat in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr bond yields end flat in slow trading.

text.p: Benchmark three-year corporate yields closed unchanged in slow trading on Tuesday, dealers said.
Three-month CD yields and the overnight call rate rose due to liquidity shortages at banks, they said.
The Bank of Korea said it supplied 1.7 trillion won to banks to ease the liquidity shortage.
* 3-mth CDs end at 12.85 pct vs Monday's 12.80
* Average overnight call rate at 11.8 pct vs Monday's 11.3
